arch.main_summary:
Main plan written to /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-DSSE/85db304a-b0fa-5d03-b685-f9acf8fac842/scratchpad/r1b/plan/runde1b_plan.md (about 118 KB, English). It follows the round-2 plan's model and has sections 0-9.

What it contains:
- How to read it and how it relates to the four part files. Measurement rules stay only in the parts; this file owns the shared objects, sessions, accounts, tiers, keys, global gates, round-level families and budget.
- A request-to-part table with 23 rows and five lines of round-1/2 context.
- The model and its inputs, with exact files, keys and Drive locations.
- 19 shared objects, each defined once with its owner and users. The main ones are SO-AX, SO-DMG, SO-JLENS, SO-CL, SO-LENSOUT, SO-HN (with H_op), SO-CHH, SO-LAB (with the new split S_L), SO-LCE, SO-D1STIM, SO-WT103, SO-LONGDOC, SO-TURN and SO-GVRA. The others are infrastructure: SO-PVAL, SO-KEYS (a key-namespace registry with a collision argument), SO-PILOT and SO-XFER.
- Each part's statistics conventions, and seven round-level confirmatory families:
  - CF-R+ and CF-R- (from part R);
  - CF-D (from part D);
  - CF-K-attr and CF-K-link (from part K);
  - CF-L (from part L);
  - CF-HERR, which pairs K8c with L5c.
  Everything else is exploratory.
- The inverse-free table: every reconstruction goes through the generate-verify-revise-abstain loop (SO-GVRA), allowed forward maps are named, and inverses are banned.
- 32 cross-part conflicts with their resolutions.
- A gate index: global gates SG1-SG10 plus every gate of R, D, K and L, and the cross-part dependencies.
- Budget and sessions:
  - one engineering pilot, r1b_P0, before the freeze;
  - 26 tier-1 and tier-2 sessions named r1b_<part>_<label>, each with its account, wave and start conditions;
  - per-part and per-account totals and a drop order.
- Where each verdict is computed. The round-level analysis r1b_ana runs on a CPU runtime and includes L-ANA.
- Scripts: the code freeze with sha256 values checked against the repository, modules per part, tests and an inverse-free lint.
- Open decisions (OD-M1 to OD-M30), dropped items, and the freeze: files, freeze record, what may happen before the freeze, amendments, roles.

Key decisions:
- u*_b is the round-2 file; K's and D's rebuild becomes a check.
- K's RSI and sea channels use R's new 1b axes (AX-1b).
- Each part calibrates damage on its own reference, and all calibrated damage is also reported on one shared reference (REF-U32).
- L gets a proper TriviaQA split S_L, screened by K.
- K4's wrong-item cell rises from 128 to 150.
- L5's generation moves to r1b_L_B.
- D_B, D_C and R's S5 move to account A, which balances the accounts at 15.5 h in A and 15.1 h in B.

Budget:
- Tier 1 is 30.6 A100-h. No rule was changed to reach it: pilots, R's conditional sessions, L's extensions and D5-x became pilot or tier 2.
- Tier 2 is 7.5 h and the pilot 1.1 h.
- At half the planned rates, tier 1 would actually use about 39.8 h.
